    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">分享一些程序员很棘手但是却又简单的工具</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>这个问题很复杂，其实也很简单，比如用某包生成的图，去除或统一背景，可以到网上搜索在线抠图或图片切片，下面分享的这些<span style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>工具完全免费</strong></span>，绝不弄虚作假</p>
<p>必经是自己做的，方便大家！</p>
<h2><a href="https://www.noplay.top/image-cut/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">第一个 设计图切成碎片</a></h2>
<p>原图</p>
<p><img alt="龙虾icon图设计 (3)" width="245" height="245" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1365095/202606/1365095-20260617180003565-1917590737.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;上传后就自动帮你切图了</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="637" height="344" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1365095/202606/1365095-20260617180050715-773700123.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><a href="https://www.noplay.top/image-cut/" rel="noopener nofollow">我也试试</a></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong>链接&nbsp;https://www.noplay.top/image-cut/</strong></span></p>
<h2><a href="https://www.noplay.top/audio-trim/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">第二个 音频截取</a></h2>
<p>可以截取音频中的一段并保存</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="621" height="336" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1365095/202606/1365095-20260617180725336-1722935366.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&nbsp;链接：https://www.noplay.top/audio-trim/</span></strong></p>
<h2><a href="https://www.noplay.top/audio-convert/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">第三个 音频格式转换</a></h2>
<p><img alt="image" width="636" height="187" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1365095/202606/1365095-20260617180957840-853692532.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&nbsp;地址&nbsp;https://www.noplay.top/audio-convert/</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><a href="https://www.noplay.top/font-subset/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">第四个&nbsp; 字体精简</a></h2>
<p>程序员常见的问题就是产品给下载了一个10M的字体，说这个字体好看，就用这个，那我们怎么办？</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="595" height="416" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1365095/202606/1365095-20260617181252823-468042038.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong>链接 https://www.noplay.top/font-subset/</strong></span></p>
<h2><a href="https://www.noplay.top/qr-code/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong>第五个 二维码生成器</strong></span></a></h2>
<p><img alt="image" width="597" height="334" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1365095/202606/1365095-20260617181620259-1214036211.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;链接&nbsp;&nbsp;https://www.noplay.top/qr-code/</p>
